AVALON HOLDINGS CORPORATION ANNOUNCES SECOND QUARTER RESULTS
data.description:
WARREN, Ohio, Aug, 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Avalon Holdings Corporation (NYSE Amex: AWX) today announced financial results for the second quarter of 2026.

Net operating revenues in the second quarter of 2026 were $20.9 million compared with $20.3 million in the second quarter of 2025. The Company recorded net income attributable to Avalon Holdings Corporation common shareholders of $0.9 million in the second quarter of 2026 compared with net income attributable to Avalon Holdings Corporation common shareholders of $0.3 million in the second quarter of 2025. For the second quarter of 2026, basic net income per share attributable to Avalon Holdings Corporation common shareholders was $0.23 compared with basic net income per share attributable to Avalon Holdings Corporation common shareholders of $0.07 in the second quarter of 2025.

For the first six months of 2026, net operating revenues were $38.6 million compared with $36.3 million for the first six months of 2025. The Company recorded a net loss attributable to Avalon Holdings Corporation common shareholders of approximately $0.4 million in the first six months of 2026 compared with net loss attributable to Avalon Holdings Corporation common shareholders of $1.2 million in the first six months of 2025. For the first six months of 2026, basic net loss per share attributable to Avalon Holdings Corporation common shareholders was $0.09 compared with basic net loss per share attributable to Avalon Holdings Corporation common shareholders of $0.31 in the first six months of 2025.

Avalon Holdings Corporation provides waste management services to industrial, commercial, municipal and governmental customers in selected northeastern and midwestern U.S. markets, captive landfill management services and salt water injection well operations. Avalon Holdings Corporation also owns Avalon Resorts and Clubs Inc., which includes the operation of a hotel and its associated resort amenities, four golf courses and related country clubs and a multipurpose recreation center.

indie Semiconductor, Inc. Q2 2026: Revenue $64M, EPS $(0.17) — 10-Q Summary
data.description:
indie Semiconductor, Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $64M, up 24% year-over-year, while the company posted a net loss attributable to shareholders of $(37.1)M and diluted EPS of $(0.17), both modestly improved from the year-ago quarter — a 10-Q summary.

Financial Highlights

  • Revenue: $64.0M for Q2 2026, up from $51.6M in the year-ago quarter (24% YoY).
  • Net income: Net loss attributable to shareholders $(37.1)M for Q2 2026, versus net loss $(39.0)M in the year-ago quarter (improved YoY).
  • Diluted EPS: $(0.17) for Q2 2026, versus $(0.20) in the year-ago quarter (improved YoY).

Business Highlights

  • Revenue growth in Q2 was driven by higher product volumes; first-half revenue rose 13% to $119.5M.
  • Geographic mix shifted toward Asia, with roughly 70% of H1 product shipments serving Asian customers (up from 61% the prior year).
  • The company is exiting commoditized Wuxi product lines to refocus capital and R&D on ADAS SoC and sensor platforms.
  • M&A and technology moves include the completed emotion3D acquisition (Sept 2025) and an agreed acquisition of ams-OSRAM’s CMOS business expected in Q3 2026 to strengthen vision-sensor capabilities.
  • COGS increased with higher volumes; R&D and SG&A have stabilized after 2025 restructuring, with continued investment in ADAS programs.

Original SEC Filing: indie Semiconductor, Inc. [ INDI ] - 10-Q - Aug. 07, 2026

data.title: bioAffinity Technologies, Inc. Q2 2026: Revenue $1.51M, EPS $(0.64) — 10-Q Summary
data.description:
bioAffinity Technologies, Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $1.51M, a 19% increase versus the year‑ago quarter, while the company narrowed its net loss to $3.37M and reported diluted loss per share of $(0.64).

Financial Highlights

  • Revenue: $1.51M for Q2 2026, up from $1.27M in the year‑ago quarter (19% YoY).
  • Net income: Net loss of $3.37M for Q2 2026, improved from a net loss of $4.06M in the year‑ago quarter.
  • Diluted EPS: $(0.64) per share for Q2 2026, versus $(5.07) per share in the year‑ago quarter.

Business Highlights

  • CyPath® Lung momentum: Year-to-date CyPath Lung revenue rose about 156%, and unit sales increased 216% in Q2, reflecting accelerating physician adoption.
  • Channel shift: The acquisition of Village Oaks and transition to in-house PPLS lab operations enabled direct commercialization of testing.
  • Market traction: Ordering physicians expanded 122% in Q2; more than 1,200 tests had been reported by July, alongside a published clinical white paper.
  • Clinical and pipeline progress: Opened 11 trial sites (including nine VA/military locations) for a longitudinal trial started March 2026 with patient enrollment underway; advancing diagnostics for lung inflammation and topical siRNA therapeutics with positive preclinical and early results.

Original SEC Filing: bioAffinity Technologies, Inc. [ BIAF ] - 10-Q - Aug. 07, 2026

data.title: WILSON BANK HOLDING CO Q2 2026: Revenue $94.7M, Net income $20.81M, EPS $1.69— 10-Q Summary
data.description:
Wilson Bank Holding Co reported second-quarter 2026 results with higher revenue and earnings versus the year-ago quarter, driven by an increase in net interest income and fee income even as mortgage sale gains declined and the company completed a credit card portfolio sale.

Financial Highlights

  • Revenue was $94.7M, compared with $90M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 5.3%.
  • Net income was $20.81M, compared with $19.12M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 8.9%.
  • Diluted EPS was $1.69, compared with $1.59 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 6.3%.

Business Highlights

  • Revenue growth and profitability: Net earnings rose 8.9% year over year for the quarter (H1 earnings up 21.3%), supported by higher net interest income and growth in fee income.
  • Deposit & lending momentum: Loans grew about 3% in the first half of 2026, with focus on owner-occupied commercial real estate, residential real estate and small business lending; deposits showed modest increases.
  • Channel & product shift: The company sold its credit card portfolio in January 2026 and will subservice the portfolio through April 2027, freeing resources to prioritize core lending and new credit card offerings.
  • Fee & non-interest income: Brokerage and deposit service fees increased; mortgage loan sale gains decreased due to higher rates; the credit card sale generated a $1.1M premium.
  • Operational investments: Wilson increased headcount and spending on technology, marketing, data security, a human capital management system and branch remodels to support growth and digital services.

Original SEC Filing: WILSON BANK HOLDING CO [ WBHC ] - 10-Q - Aug. 07, 2026

data.title: Sharplink, Inc. Q2 2026: Revenue $11.5M, Net loss $394.3M, EPS $(1.88) — 10-Q Summary
data.description:
Sharplink, Inc. reported results for the second quarter of 2026: revenue rose to $11.5M from $0.7M a year earlier while the company recorded a net loss of $394.3M compared with a net loss of $103.4M in Q2 2025; diluted loss per share was $(1.88) versus $(4.27) in the prior-year quarter.

Financial Highlights

  • Revenue: $11.5M for Q2 2026, up from $0.7M in Q2 2025 (1,554% YoY).
  • Net income: Net loss $394.3M for Q2 2026, versus net loss $103.4M in Q2 2025 (worse by $290.9M YoY).
  • Diluted EPS: $(1.88) for Q2 2026, versus $(4.27) in Q2 2025.

Business Highlights

  • Total revenue surged roughly 1,539% year-to-date, driven primarily by expansion of ETH staking revenue.
  • Strategic pivot to an ETH treasury as the primary asset: staking, liquid staking and restaking are now central to operations.
  • Institutional positioning advanced through partnerships including ether.fi, Linea and Consensys, and inclusion in a Russell index.
  • Operational milestones included launching ETH segments, executing an SPA for Linea deployment, and establishing a $125M Galaxy onchain yield fund.
  • Affiliate marketing revenue declined about 34–45% amid softer iGaming demand while the treasury scaled rapidly.

Original SEC Filing: Sharplink, Inc. [ SBET ] - 10-Q - Aug. 07, 2026
